note: Byte-identical copies of PyNifly test assets at the commit pinned in tools/nifly/build_niflydll.py, all listed in its PYNIFLY_SPARSE. Game data (c) Bethesda; kept only as offline test references. cfm.fit.reference_path uses third_party/PyNifly/tests/tests/<path> when present and falls back to these copies, because build_niflydll.fetch() does not re-apply an extended PYNIFLY_SPARSE in a checkout that is already at the pinned commit. Remove this folder once fetch() does.
